caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn carriage with two white horses harnessed at the front. The horses are in motion, facing to the left, with red and black harnesses and black hooves. The carriage has four large brown wheels and a body that is primarily off-white with a dark blue lower section. The upper part of the carriage’s roof is red, with a small green section at the front. The side of the carriage has five rectangular windows with black fill, and through some windows, silhouettes of heads are visible. There is a pink and gold decorative motif below the windows. The words “BROADWAY & 4th AVENUE” are written in red near the top edge of the carriage’s side. At the front, a man is seated atop the carriage roof, holding onto the reins. He is dressed in a red jacket, green pants, yellow boots, and a blue garment over his knees, with black hair and light skin. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "O. Middleton," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Toy Bus
